nodes.text: Photographers, Golden Friday 🌟 Show me the most golden thing in your camera roll. A sunflower, a sunset, a streetlamp glowing at dusk - if it glows gold, it counts. ONE photo. 3 favorites featured tomorrow, pin to my profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit. Yesterday’s favorites’ in.
nodes.photo: A large, ruffled, yellow-orange sunflower stands in the foreground against a clear blue sky. Other sunflowers and green foliage are visible in the slightly blurred background.

replies.photo: A horizontal, eye-level, medium shot features a landscape with a river and trees under a cloudy sky. The cloudy sky shows a mix of white and pink clouds. The grassy bank of the river is visible in the lower right foreground.

nodes.text: Shadow Thursday favorites 🏆 Four shadows that stopped me mid-scroll. Full credit to the photographers - tagged below. 1. @petestretchphotos - B&W, one long shadow racing across wet sand toward the water 2. @nofussgus_ - a mid-leap dog with its long shadow chasing behind 3. @bojonvelvet2.0 - a red chair wearing window-blind stripes 4. @ahm0711 - sunset leaking through a dune fence, striping the sand Each of you gets a question in the thread below - answer if you like. We'd love the story.
nodes.photo: A high-angle, vertical, grayscale photograph shows three children standing at the edge of the water on a wide, sandy beach, while a young girl runs toward them from the foreground. The sky is pale blue with white, puffy clouds and the ocean is dark, calm, and reflecting the sunlight. The camera is at a slightly low angle, capturing the scene with a shallow depth of field. The lighting is bright and sunny, creating a high-contrast effect between the light sand and the darker ocean. The children are silhouetted against the bright water, while the girl in the foreground is in focus and her shadow is cast behind her on the wet sand.

replies.photo: A person wades along the wet sand at the water's edge, silhouetted against a bright, sunlit ocean where a strong sunburst breaks through the sky overhead.
